notes.title: Attention: About floating buildings and totems and update preview
notes.content:
We will update in 1 day，Here are some previews of this update. This is only for the players on the server. The stand-alone game model will not be affected, but it will have a certain impact on the buildings of the server players.
[olist]
 After the update, Totems can be destroyed in any mode. Change back to allow multiple people to interact with totem, so you need to place the totems in your own house and lock the door with a password lock to prevent others from destroying and interacting with your totems. The reason for this change is that a large number of totems in the PVE mode are arbitrarily built to occupy a large area of ​​land, causing the PVE server to be full, making it impossible for novice players to play the game. In the long run, the server will crash due to a large amount of data. It cannot be allowed to be built like this. The start point area will also be prohibited from construction. After the update, animals will also damage player buildings, so a circle of spiked walls must be built for defense.
 About floating buildings, The server will check the support every 10 minutes. Floating buildings without support on the server will automatically collapse. If you have such floating buildings on the server, Please recycle your items in the storage box of the floating building. , Note: This is a check function only for server buildings, stand-alone mode and personal servers are not affected
 
[/olist]

notes.title: v1.1.6 Important fixes and improvements
notes.content:
☑ Support for screen resolution of 3440x1440, fix the bug that the interface of opening the furnace and the box is blocked
 ☑ Fix the character become bigger problem caused by riding a wolf
 ☑ The server is full and it is displayed, and the prompt is full
 ☑ Increased the height of the player's death respawn point to prevent the player from being stuck again
 ☑ Display a lock icon for multiplayer servers with passwords, prompt that you need to enter a password to access, adjust the server name color, and display the number of servers searched, Please pay attention to the download region set in your steam client, which determines whether you and your friends can search for each other. Make sure you set the same region. This will show the player server in that region.
 ☑ Due to the restrictions of the official platform of Steam, players can only create a maximum of 50 servers in multiplayer online. If you refresh and see that the number of servers is 50, it will prompt that the number of servers is full, and the newly created server may not be searched by friends. Please choose to create a server when there are fewer players
 ☑ Limitations in PVE mode are that you cannot attack buildings and pets
 ☑ Restart the frozen event, you need to build a campfire to keep warm, fix the problem of inaccurate temperature display, directly obtain the variable value from the character, and ensure that the character must be at the corresponding extreme cold temperature when HP is deducted
 ☑ Greatly increased the number and probability of horses spawning in 2 maps, so please prepare 30 apples to tame it, you can buy apples from NPC
 ☑ Adjust the maximum stacking number of cooked meat to 30, and the raw meat to 50
 ☑ Adjust the terrain problem on the edge of the city
 ☑ Adjust the ice material of the ice spike fence wall
 ☑ Reduce the maximum time for fish to bite the hook by 2 minutes and the shortest by 10 seconds
 ☑ Fix the error in item description
 ☑ Items dropped on the ground will be automatically destroyed in 30 minutes to prevent a large amount of data from accumulating over time. It is best to store your items in a storage box and pick up the items on the ground as soon as possible

notes.title: Dear 500,000 Players Friends
notes.content:
Nearly 500,000 players have already claimed（ Ice World ), and nearly 2,000 players play the game every day. Thank you for your support and feedback! Your encouragement is our motivation to keep going.
Why can't the created multiplayer server be searched by friends? Since multiplayer online uses a personal computer as a server, this is a service officially provided by Steam, so the current limit is to only create 50 servers. There are currently a lot of players and it is always fully loaded. You can wait until there are fewer people to create a room. We are also actively looking for solutions.

notes.title: v1.1.3 New server upgrade and mouse settings fix
notes.content:
The Asian server has been temporarily shut down for maintenance. Hardware upgrades, archives have been migrated to new servers, and the maximum number of player on the server has been upgraded to support 100 players online at the same time. You need to restart the steam client and update the latest version v1.1.3 to enter the server
 If your mouse sensitivity or inversion has problems, please set it in the input settings
 Re-enable the mouse inversion Invert function, and add the function of setting the x and y axis inversion separately
 Re-enable the mouse sensitivity setting and fix the setting problem
 Adjust the game mode to PVE, temporarily turn off the PVP mode, and you can no longer attack other players. The PVP mode will be added again in the future, Now cooperate with your friends to survive
 Improve the death respawn method, and you will be respawned randomly in the area near the death point. You'd better build a bed to store the respawn  point and respawn  on the bed next time

notes.title: v1.1.2 Important Fixes
notes.content:
☑ The Official servers in Europe, North America, Asia has been temporarily shut down for maintenance and update.
 ☑ Fixed the character rotation error when riding an animal in the riding state.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150642/c7948ef42534672b2a732b2d5a87577db9f0d519.png
 ☑ Adjusted the animal taming method. When an animal is attacked, it only has 30 HP left, the dizzy icon will be displayed and the item can be tamed according to the prompt. Be careful not to kill the animal when you attack it at the end. You can switch to fists to do less damage.
 ☑ Fixed the problem that the female character's voice was not set to sound attenuation, which caused all clients to hear her attack, jump and death sound.
 ☑ Added a larger collision body for the death backpack to prevent it from falling to the ground below or rolling to other places.
 ☑ Set the death backpack icon to be displayed only on your own client and not let others see it.
 ☑ Some players reported that they occasionally encountered the problem of mouse Invert. Temporarily tested and did not encounter this bug. Temporarily remove the mouse Invert function.
 ☑ Fixed the excessive mouse rotation caused by sitting down and standing up. Now the standing up animation will be played when standing up. You can also press Z to sit down and stand up.
 ☑ Fixed the temperature display bug of the temperature component on the server, reduced the speed of HP drop caused by damage during the freezing event, changed to damage once every 5 seconds, and reduced the difficulty of the game. When a freezing event comes, remember to build a campfire to keep warm and wait for the temperature to rise.

Listen to the whistling wind in the cozy snow house, and hope you can find peace in the aurora on a cold night.
We are a small studio with 2 people. Please give us some time and patience to update the game. We welcome your feedback in the community. We will record your feedback and suggestions to help us improve the game in the future, Thank you!

notes.title: Will be free for a limited time!
notes.content:
h2]The game will be free for a limited time! 
We will make the game free for a limited time. Hurry up and notify your friends to claim the game. You can play the game online with your friends. After claiming it, it will be permanently stored in your library and you will enjoy all future updates!
Impact on current players 
If you have already purchased this game, please apply for a refund and choose to store it after the game is free. The official Steam customer service will refund you. 
Why we're making the game free?
We will invite all players to and testing to collect feedback in order to better improve the game.
When will it be free? 
According to the requirements of the official Steam customer service, it will take a week after this announcement is issued for the official to set it to free status. In addition to the processing time of the Steam customer service, it is estimated that it will be free in 10-16 days. You can add it to your attention or wish list or shopping cart first. Please wait patiently.

notes.title: v1.01 Important fixes and improvements
notes.content:

 Reduced the density and number of animals in the snow village map, reduced the difficulty of the game, and blocked the generation of animals near the village
 Fixed some description errors
 Added a prompt for splitting inventory items: Shift+left mouse button drag to split half of the item, Ctrl+left mouse button drag to split an item
 Fixed some glacier distribution and floating issues
 Modified bed interaction prompt: Interact to store respawn points and clear respawn points, and respawn  the bed next time after store respawn points
 Corrected entry translations in some national languages
